title: Jarvis+ (refined)
direction: A refined, more polished version of the reference character: keep his exact colors, glossy eyes and banana headset, but improve the anatomy - clearer clumped stylized fur, softer calm brows, a wider expressive mouth, slightly larger hands, crisper silhouette.
traits: 1:2.5 head-to-body, clumped stylized fur, soft brows, big eyes, rim light, one accent color

title: Silverback Bruiser
direction: Heavier gorilla-like bulk: a massive rounded brow ridge, very wide shoulders, huge knuckle-forward forearms, a slight hunch, a short silvery-grey fur saddle across the back and shoulders. Eyes stay big and warm so he reads gentle, not villainous. Rounded shapes everywhere, no pointy ears.
traits: gargoyle-like hunched mass, knuckle stance, heavy but rounded brow, gentle eyes (contrast comedy)

title: Athletic V-Taper
direction: Leaner sprinter-athlete build: dramatic V-taper, defined but not bulky muscles, slightly longer legs (still cartoon short), a light athletic tank top in banana yellow with a single cyan stripe, sporty wristband on one wrist. Keep the big head and huge eyes so he stays friendly.
traits: broad chest to narrow waist, longer legs balanced by big head and eyes

title: Kawaii Chibi
direction: Super-cute chibi version: about 1:1.6 head-to-body, very round head, extra-large sparkly eyes, a round squishy torso that still shows a tiny cartoon six-pack, short beefy stub arms, tiny feet, rosy cheeks.
traits: 1:1 to 1:2 proportions, round torso, beefy stub forearms, oversized eyes

title: Jungle Streetwear
direction: Streetwear style: a sleeveless cropped hoodie vest in leaf-green that shows off his big arms, chunky oversized sneakers in white with banana-yellow accents, a simple chain-free look. No caps, no logos, no text on clothes. Clothes are simple, chunky and easy to model.
traits: hoodie vest showing arms, oversized sneakers balance tiny legs, single accent color

title: Jungle Guardian
direction: Protector of the jungle: a broad green leaf-bandana tied around his forehead (big leaf shapes, not a black band), thin green vine bands around the biceps (no hand wraps), a small carved wooden banana pendant. Earthy greens and browns, heroic but warm.
traits: nature accessories that read as shapes, heroic stance, earthy palette with one accent

title: Retro Rubber-Hose Mascot
direction: 1930s rubber-hose cartoon style interpreted in modern 3D: bendy noodle-like limbs without visible elbows, white puffy cartoon gloves, pie-cut highlights in the eyes, bouncy exaggerated pose, his bulk toned down into a round barrel chest. Keep his brown and cream colors and the banana headset.
traits: rubber-hose limbs, bouncy pose, round shapes, vintage appeal

title: Sci-Fi Sidekick
direction: Tech-assistant look: the headset becomes a sleek banana-yellow tech band with small cyan glowing ear fins, a slim translucent cyan visor that floats in front of his eyes (eyes still visible), thin cyan glowing seams on a minimal chest harness, a tiny hovering banana-shaped drone. No glasses, no armor plates, no weapons.
traits: tech that shows assistant state (glow/LEDs), light muzzle, soft brows
